name: luch
description: Connect Kimi to authorized LUCH tools through OAuth-scoped remote MCP. Capabilities depend on user consent, active hosts, and granted permissions.
author: Lenar Salimov

interface.shortDescription: Connect Kimi to your authorized tools and devices
interface.longDescription: Use user-authorized LUCH capabilities across browsers, files, servers and connected devices. Access requires explicit OAuth authorization; individual capabilities and permission scopes vary by account and host.
